claim_boundary: independent confirmation of predeclared base-fit global descriptor directions; no geometry mechanism, channel relation, routing, adaptation, learning, or causal claim
target_rule: Each condition applies its listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities; paired histories retain the evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target within 1e-12.
fitting_rule: Fit projection, mean/scale, tracker, and rank-8 subspace basis only on base-order train32 cue6-to-delay8 states; apply unchanged objects to paired eval32 clouds.
aggregation: Within seed, median base-minus-upstream descriptor difference across fixed projections.
confirmation_rule: Each descriptor confirms only if its base-minus-upstream direction matches the preceding prospective geometry batch in at least three of four fresh seeds. Report order readout only as control. Do not nominate channels or interventions.
